dm.compromised:
Your message in **{guild}** was removed because it looked like a scam.

**If you didn't send it, your account is probably compromised.** Do this now:
> Change your password and turn on 2FA
> Log out of all devices (Settings → Devices)
> Remove apps you don't recognize (Settings → Authorized Apps)
> Scan your PC for malware

[Discord's guide for hacked accounts](https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/24160905919511-My-Discord-Account-was-Hacked-or-Compromised)

If you sent it on purpose, talk to the server's staff.

setup.title: # Thanks for adding Frostbite!
setup.body:
I protect this server from scams — phishing links, scam images, and compromised-account spam. Setup takes two commands (needs **Manage Server**):

**1.** `/filter quicksetup log_channel:#your-log-channel` — turns the scam filters on and picks where removals are reported
**2.** `/filter status` — see what's configured and what still needs attention

Filters cover **every channel** by default.
-# More options: `/filter categories` (exclude categories), `/filter enable` + `/filter sethoneypotchannel` (trap channel), `/filter punish` (timeout/kick/ban on a hit), `/filter setappeallink`, `/language server` (my language here).
setup.perms: -# Grant my role **View Channel**, **Read Message History**, and **Manage Messages** server-wide (plus **Ban Members** if you use the honeypot) — I can't filter channels I can't see.
